subject: general
question: At the 23rd National Para Athletics Championships 2025 in Chennai's Nehru Stadium, which state claimed the top position in the combined men's and women's team standings?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Haryana**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Haryana** emerged as the overall champion at the **23rd National Para Athletics Championships**, which concluded in **January 2025**.
 
• The prestigious event was organized at the **Nehru Stadium** located in **Chennai**, **Tamil Nadu**, under the aegis of the **Paralympic Committee of India (PCI)**.
 
• **Haryana** dominated the medals tally by securing a total of **131 medals**, which included **53 gold**, **45 silver**, and **33 bronze** medals.
 
• The host state, **Tamil Nadu**, secured the **second position** in the combined standings with a total of **58 medals** (**18 gold**, **21 silver**, and **19 bronze**).
 
• **Maharashtra** finished in the **third position**, claiming **53 medals** in total, comprising **18 gold**, **15 silver**, and **20 bronze** medals.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Paralympic Committee of India (PCI):**
 
 
• The **PCI** is the apex body for promoting para-sports in the country and is recognized by the **International Paralympic Committee (IPC)**.
 
• The current President of the **PCI** is **Devendra Jhajharia**, a **two-time Paralympic gold medalist** in javelin throw.
 
 
 
• **Classification in Para Athletics:**
 
 
• Athletes are categorized into different classes based on their impairment to ensure fair competition. For example, **'T'** stands for **Track** events and **'F'** stands for **Field** events.
 
• Specific numbers follow the prefix, such as **T42** or **F57**, denoting the type and level of physical limitation.
 
 
 
• **Growth of Para Sports in India:**
 
 
• Following India's record-breaking performances at the **Tokyo 2020** and **Paris 2024 Paralympics**, there has been a significant increase in government funding and public interest in para-athletics.
 
• The **Khelo India Para Games**, launched recently, further complements the **National Championships** in identifying grassroots talent.
 
 
 
• **Nehru Stadium, Chennai:**
 
 
• It is a multi-purpose stadium with a capacity of approximately **40,000** people and is a hub for athletics in **South India**.
 
• The stadium provided world-class facilities for the **23rd edition** of the championships, ensuring accessibility for all competing athletes.
